reporting_rate_exact.tie_limitation: rank(method='first') is deterministic for ties only after preserving the source endpoint Parquet row order; Fable's original tie-row convention was not supplied, so no cutoff was tuned to the claimed medians

scope.class_support_rule: all presences against class-specific backgrounds; >=20 presences and >=20 backgrounds in every fold; equal fold mean; common panels inherit the frozen first-review three-class support set
scope.processing: one process, one target at a time; FT all157 and TO matched142 only; BLAS/OpenMP caps set before numerical work
scope.reporting_ratios: lower-bin reporting proportions divided by reference, clipped above at 1; companion pooled100+ reference is unclipped
scope.reporting_reference: literal fixed 200+ and separately each target's highest nonempty top-decile bin
scope.reporting_rule: selected conventional target100 OOF scores; within each held fold rank(method='first'), pandas qcut(10), top labels 8 and 9 pooled; original endpoint Parquet row order resolves score ties
scope.richness_name: other-species richness = frozen effort_richness - focal y; richness strata, not measured effort
